reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown treat the 'forty years' of 2 Samuel 15:7 as a copying error, adopting the Syriac, Arabic, and Josephus reading of 'four years' instead.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the received text at face value, noting that 'forty years' after David's own forty-year reign places Absalom's revolt beyond David's death.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
sides.verseText: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

sides.snippet: It happened at the end of forty years, that Absalom said to the king, please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.
sides.verseText: It happened at the end of forty years, that Absalom said to the king, please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.
